— Uvula and Tonsils. Tonsils, uvula, and soft part of palate

at 11.45 A.M. (fourteenth day)/. — ^Pain all afternoon in right side of neck,

— Appetite* Appetite poor (twelfth day); could eat no

— Ate DO breakfast, and at 11 a m. had a darting-sticking pain in great

some irritating or burning substance had been taken into the stomach
(eleventh day ),**. — [ 280 .] Tenderness in entire epigastric region, most

noon, hut still distinctly felt on pressing the part (twenty-fifth day),*V —
